The training camp season has arrived once 
again. Riding her motorcycle like a true 
outlaw, Vodka overtook the bus to arrive 
at the camp facility.

In truth, however, that bike actually 
belonged to her father. She had just 
ridden along on the back with him to make 
herself look cool.

And so, the summer training camp with that 
pretentious girl began once again!
